title: License a veterinary hospital for major surgery
what: Perform major surgery on animals only at premises with a veterinary hospital licence that authorises it.

sources.title: Veterinary Practice Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not perform major surgery on an animal except at premises that are the subject of a veterinary hospital licence that authorises major surgery of the type concerned to be carried out at those premises.
